Ketty has got a hearing impairment and asthma which needs better treatment. Ketty has not yet been enrolled in school because in her area of residence there’s no school for children with such a disability and also her aunt doesn’t have money to enroll her in school. Ketty loves playing with other children though she finds it hard to communicate. Supporting Ketty through education will help her learn better communication skills.

children.name: Nambozo Leah
story: Leah is  7 years old in primary two. She lives with both her parents, who are peasant farmers. Her father also takes on construction work occasionally to supplement their small income. The family’s earnings are often unstable, making it difficult to provide basic needs and pay school fees consistently. Leah would like to become  a nurse or a dentist . She loves eating rice and vegetables and enjoys playing with her friends. Sponsorship will help Leah stay in school and work toward achieving her dream.

children.name: Nambozo Lydia
story: Lydia Nambozo is 23 years old and suffered terrible accident as an infant. One unfortunate day a candle was left burning in the room she was resting in and the room caught fire. By the time Lydia was rescued the fire had severely burned her arm and head. This led to the loss of the left arm and a scar on her forehead. Because of the large size of the family and the special care Lydia requires she has come to live at Berakhah. Lydia just completed her high school education awaiting results to join a tertiary institution. At Berakhah, Lydia is a tremendous help and even though she has had to overcome tremendous challenges she hopes to become a doctor one day. This can be made possible by your generous sponsorship.

children.name: Nambozo Mary
story: Mary is 12 years old and she’s in primary 4 staying at Berakhah Child Care, she was living with her parents until they separated that everything in her life changed. Mary’s mother remarried, Mary was in an environment which was not good for a child because even her mother at times would become drunk and forgets to take good care of the child. Berakhah staff requested her mother to entrust the child with the ministry something which she agreed since she couldn’t even afford taking her to school. Mary found herself at Berakhah and she is doing good now because she gets all the care and basic needs of the child and also she attends school regularly, Mary would like to become a fashion designer or a nurse when she grows up.

children.name: Nambozo Miracle
story: Miracle is 8 years old and she is in primary three living with her parents who are peasant farmers and struggle to provide for their family of eight due to the limited sources of income.   Miracle would like to become a teacher, her best color is yellow and her best dish is Matoke and chicken. While at home, Miracle loves cooking, washing utensils, digging and sweeping the compound. Miracle attends Berakhah children’s church and she is very active in church activities.  With the right support, she can continue her studies uninterrupted and work toward achieving her aspirations.

children.name: Nambozo Trinity
story: Trinity is 13 years old and she lives with her grandmother after the death of both her parents. The grandmother is a peasant farmer and depends only on the garden produce for sale to get some income. Trinity being the oldest at home she engages in hawking of tomatoes every evening and over the weekend in their village. The grandmother is very old and her health is so worrying especially therefore she cannot do a lot of work. Due to financial challenges, Trinity’s attendance in school is irregular and this affects her performance, she has always been school fees defaulter. To contribute on school fees at school, sometimes her grandmother will take some of the garden produce at school to be converted to fees. Trinity would like to be a teacher when she grows up so she can give support to her grandmother and the young siblings.

children.name: Nambozo Vasha
story: Vasha is 14 years old in Primary 5 and she lives with her parents who are peasant farmers. Vasha’s father also runs a small retail shop in the community which helps him to supplement on the income got from garden produce. Vasha’s parents are both victims of HIV/AIDS and this has greatly affected their abilities to work for the family effectively, this has also affected Vasha’s studies as she has to miss school some days due to lack of school fees. Vasha would like to become a teacher in future and her best subject is social studies, she loves singing and dancing and her best sport is netball. Vasha loves eating Matoke and meat and her best color is blue. While at home Vasha helps her parents to do most of the home chores like digging, fetching water attending to the shop and cooking. Your sponsorship will ensure that Vasha is in school and she will be able to achieve her dream of becoming a teacher.

children.name: Nambuba Phiona
story: Phiona is 19 years old and she is in senior three. she lives with her parents who depend on small scale farming to survive. They usually grow beans, cassava, and maize but their income is very limited and often not enough to meet the family’s basic needs. At home, Phiona helps with daily chores such as washing dishes, cleaning the compound, and even digging in the garden to support the family. Despite these responsibilities, she remains committed to her education and performs well in school. In her free time, Phiona enjoys playing netball, skipping rope, and singing with her friends. She dreams of becoming a nurse so she can support her community. Your support towards Phiona’s wellbeing will help her achieve her dream.

children.name: Namono Gladys
story: Gladys is 5 years old and she is in primary one. She lives with her parents and siblings. Her mother sells sweet bananas by the roadside to earn some income, while her father works on a sugarcane plantation where he earns very little. Unfortunately, their combined income is not enough to meet the family’s needs or keep all the children in school. Gladys loves eating beef and rice and she enjoys playing with her friends. She would like to become a teacher one day, Sponsorship will help Gladys continue with her education and bring her closer to achieving her dream.

children.name: Namono Rhodah Julia
story: Rhodah is 6 years old and she lives with her father and 5 siblings. Rhoda’s father is motor cycle rider as a source of income, her mother left them behind till to date she has never returned. Her father’s income is very little to sustain the whole family he therefore gets vegetables for Rhodah and her siblings to hawk after school to supplement on what he earns so they can be able to feed and pay school fees. Rhodah is a jolly girl and she loves singing and skipping ropes during her free time, when she grows up Rhoda would like to become a footballer as she enjoys playing football with boys. Your support will enable Rhodah to become successful in life

children.name: Namono Suzan
story: Suzan is 7 years old and she stays with her parents. Her parents operate a local brewery to earn a living, her father is aging and yet the children are still young and require much care in provision of school fees and basic needs. Suzan usually helps her parents during the production of the local brew sold by her parents, this kind of business is not good to expose a girl child to it as there so many risks involved, Suzan would like to become a teacher after her studies. This can only be realized if Suzan attends school and leaves her parent’s environment which is a threat to her wellbeing. Your support towards Suzan will enable her to leave the unhealthy environment to a better location and also she will be able to concentrate in school.

children.name: Namonye Peter
story: Peter is 5 years old attending kindergarten, he lives with his maternal grandmother. After his father’s early death and his mother’s unexplained absence, his grandmother has taken up the responsibility of caring for him and his siblings. Despite her tireless efforts, the meager income she earns from peasantry farming often marred by unpredictable weather and pest infestations makes it difficult to cover everyday expenses and the school fees required for the children’s education.

children.name: Namulembwa Bakali
story: Bakali is 13 years old boy and he is the only child of his father. His father is blind and the mother has mental disabilities. This created a wanting situation for his wellbeing so, his aunt took him in although she is challenged given that she is in a polygamous marriage with a limited source of income as she is a peasant farmer. Bakali started staying with his aunt at five years. His life was not so good because of the situation he was in which led him be so quiet and sometimes could harshly react to people.  Berakhah Child Care came to know about him and he was taken in , his life has gradually changed and he co-operates with people. Bakali is in primary four and hopes to become pilot and in his free time, likes playing football. While at home, Bakali used to cut grass for animal, sweep the compound, dig, wash plates and fetch water. Your sponsorship will support Bakali in school and his story will be changed.

children.name: Nandudu Daphine
story: Daphine is 15 years old she lives with both her parents who are peasant farmers and earn very little. Daphine has got sickle cells which has disturbed her both her daily life and school life. Her parents cannot afford her treatment as she is not the only one with sickle cell disease at home, her other three siblings are victims as well.  Daphine performs very well in class though her attendance is irregular due to lack of school fees and her health condition. After her studies, Daphine would like to become a hairdresser as she loves styling hair. Your support will not only help Daphine stay in school but also she will be able to receive proper medication.

children.name: Nandudu Gloria
story: Gloria is 15 years old and she is in primary six. She is the only child of the mother but the second child of her father. Gloria`s mother died of HIV/AIDS when Gloria was eight years. She currently stays with her father who is also infected with HIV/AIDS. He was a casual laborer but due to continuous illness, he resorted to peasant farming with no defined income to support his daughter sufficiently. During her free time, Gloria likes skipping the rope and playing netball with her friends. She wants to become a nurse. Gloria does all the house hold chores to support the family. Thank you for your consideration to support her.

children.name: Nandudu Joy
story: Joy is 7 years old and she’s in primary two living with her parents who are struggling to provide for their family’s basic needs and the educational expenses for their children. Joy is the third born in the family of 6 and she performs well in school. Because her parents ’income is very low, they are challenged when it comes to school fees payment, medical and feeding alongside managing other household responsibilities. Joy would like to become a lawyer in future, she loves dancing and singing during her free time, With support Joy can become a better person.

children.name: Nandudu Joyce
story: Joyce is 9 years old girl and she is in primary two. Joyce lost both of her parents to HIV/AIDS when she was still an infant, and she too was born with the virus. She now lives under the care of her grandmother who looks after her together with five other children. Her grandmother is a peasant farmer whose small earnings can barely sustain the family’s basic needs. Due to financial hardships, Joyce often struggles to maintain a proper diet and sometimes misses her medication (ARVs) because there is no money for transport to the nearest health center. These health challenges, combined with frequent school absences caused by unpaid school fees, make her situation even more difficult. Nevertheless, Joyce loves going to school and dreams of becoming a nurse.  In her free time, she enjoys playing dodgeball with her friends. With consistent care, education support, and access to medical needs, Joyce can have a brighter and healthier future. Sponsorship would not only keep her in school but also ensure she receives the treatment and nutrition vital for her wellbeing.

children.name: Nandudu Linah
story: Linah is 10 years old in primary four and lives lives under the care of her grandmother. When she was just two months old, her mother attempted to throw her in pit latrine at 2months but the community intervened and saved her life. Since then, her grandmother has lovingly raised her despite many challenges. Linah’s father, who used to support them, passed away when she was nine years old, leaving the grandmother as her only guardian. Because of her outstanding talent in music, dance, and drama, Linah now lives at Berakhah Childcare, where she receives care, education, and guidance. She dreams of becoming a doctor,  Linah enjoys participating in athletics at school and takes part in household chores such as cooking, washing utensils, and digging. Her favorite color is pink, and she loves eating Irish potatoes with chicken. Your sponsorship will help Linah to have a brighter future.

children.name: Nandudu Sarah
story: Sarah is 22 years old and she is currently in Senior 5. Sarah lost her father when she was 6 years old. She and other 9 siblings were left under the care of their mother who was a peasant farmer. Taking care of the 10 children was such a heavy burden for her, and since she couldn’t put all of them in school she decided to put some out of school and do farm for people to be able to get something to eat. Life became so difficult for the family that even Sarah who was the youngest couldn’t attend school regularly because of lack of school fees and basic needs. Sarah would dig, cook, wash utensils, fetch water, wash clothes and sometimes do quarrying to help her mother sustain the family. Later on, Sarah joined Berakhah childcare after she was identified from the community. Berakhah has supported Sarah since she was 13 years, she would like to be a teacher after her studies and she loves sports and singing. At Berakhah childcare Sarah gets all her basic needs, she goes to school, receives medical treatment and she’s happy because Berakhah childcare gave her opportunity to enjoy her childhood moments. Your sponsorship will open doors for her to re-write her story.

children.name: Nangoli Elijah
story: Elijah is 7 years old and he’s the last born in a family of five. He lost his father at eight months old. Elijah is now in primary one. He stays at Berakhah Child Care after his family abandoned him, his mother went missing till now no one knows about her whereabouts. Elijah would like to be a soldier after his studies, he loves eating rice and beef , his best sport is soccer and riding bicycle. At Berakhah childcare Elijah loves running and washing utensils. Your support towards Elijah through Berakhah will enable him to have a brighter future.

children.name: Nangoye Emma
story: Emma is 11 years old in primary 3 living with his single mother after the death of his father, he’s a self-motivated and ambitious person who dreams of becoming an engineer, his mother is a nursery school teacher and she takes care of 6 children from the salary that she gets at the end of month. To supplement on the income, Emma’s mother sells fruits in the community to be able to feed and to meet other family’s expenses. Emma usually helps his mother to hawk the fruits every evening and over the weekend, he loves playing soccer in his free time and telling stories. With support Emma will be able to complete his education and become an engineer.

children.name: Nangulu Pamela
story: Pamela is 12 years old in primary three. Pamela and her other 7 siblings stay with their father following the separation of her parents. Her father works on construction sites to be able to raise some money to take care of the family, while at the site he got an accident which injured his back and because of this he can’t do much to provide for his family. Pamela loves attending school because she would like to be a nurse unfortunately she has always been a fees defaulter which keeps her away from school. Pamela loves singing and dancing and while at home she loves cooking, fetching water and playing with her mates. Your generous contribution towards Pamela’s education will enable her become a nurse in future.

children.name: Napangi Yeku
story: Yeku is 8 years old and he is in Primary Two. He lives with his parents, who are peasant farmers struggling to provide for the family due to their low income. The limited resources often make it difficult to pay school fees, causing Yeku to miss classes at times. His performance is promising and he would like to be a teacher, he enjoys drawing and playing soccer with his friends. Sponsorship will help Yeku stay in school and move closer to achieving his dream.

children.name: Nasike Sarah
story: Sarah is 17 years old and in senior two class. Sarah is the fifth of six children. She lost her father at two years old after a long illness and since then she lived with her mother, a peasant farmer, who struggles with poor health and could not fully provide for Sarah’s needs. She frequently fell sick and this could worry Sarah so much who had started taking on the house responsibilities at a young age, Sarah would do all the home chores and also to work for people in the community to be able to get something to eat at home. Thankfully, Sarah was welcomed into Berakhah Child Care, where she now enjoys the love and support of a new family. Surrounded by other children with similar experiences, she has found comfort and strength in her faith. Sarah loves singing and dancing as it brings her joy and helps her forget her worries. With your sponsorship, Sarah will be able to rewrite her story.

children.name: Nasiyo Mercy
story: Mercy is 16 years old. She comes from a very large family where her elder siblings dropped out of school and got married at a very tender age. She faced rejection at birth because she was born without arms. She was rescued when she was about to be thrown in a pit latrine because of being born different. This was all because children born different in the neighborhood are viewed as a curse so most families with such children keep them away from the public to avoid public shame and insults. Growing up in a humble family with many children was a struggle. Her parents were challenged financially and couldn’t send her to school because it was very expensive to take her to a school that caters for children with special needs. At Berakhah, she found love, acceptance, and hope. All her needs are met and she now feels valued which has gotten her to hope again. She dreams of a better future, one where she can rise above her challenges and make her life meaningful, with your support Mercy can rewrite her story Your sponsorship makes a difference, not just for her, but for many children like her.

children.name: Negesa Shina Sumaya
story: Shina is 6 years old in Primary One. She lives with her grandmother after her parents separated when she was only 3 years old. Her grandmother is a peasant farmer who works very hard, but what she earns from the garden is very little. She struggles to pay school fees and to handle her family basic needs. Shina loves school and performs well in her class. She dreams of becoming a teacher in the future. Shina loves playing with friends and she loves helping with home chores at home like washing utensils, cleaning the compound. Her best dish is rice and beef and her best color is green. Your support will help Shina stay healthy and continue with her education.

children.name: Neumbe Favour
story: Favor is12 years old in primary five. She lives with both her parents who struggle to make ends meet because of the little income earned. The limited income got from their work often leave them unable to fully provide for the family’s basic needs and the educational expenses for their children. Favor has hernia which is an inconvenience to her daily activities. Favor’s performance is good and she would like to become a medical doctor after her studies. Your support towards Favor’s wellbeing will help her get an operation and also finish her studies .

children.name: Precious Irene
story: Irene is 7 years old and she is in primary three. She lives with her grandmother and mother after her father separated from her mother. Unfortunately, her father has become irresponsible due to excessive alcohol consumption, leaving Irene’s upbringing entirely to the grandmother, The grand mother is a peasant farmer limited income, struggling to meet the basic needs of the family and ensure the children’s education. Despite these financial challenges, Irene remains in good health and she would like to be a chef in future, Irene loves to play with her age mates and she is so social. At home she helps with some domestic chores like collecting firewood, fetching water and cleaning the compound, with your support Irene will stay in school and this will be an opportunity for her to have a brighter future.

children.name: Salimu Esili
story: Esili is a 13 year old boy, in Primary Four. When he was just 9 months old, both of his parents separated and left him in the care of his grandmother in the village. Since then, he has never seen them again, and no one knows where they are. His grandmother is a peasant farmer who works very hard every day to grow food and take care of him. But life is very difficult. They struggle to find enough to eat, and sometimes they go without the basic things they need. Esili needs support to stay in school and have a chance at a brighter future.

children.name: Wabulo Trevor
story: Trevor is 12 years old and he is in Primary five,He stays at Berakhah childcare, Trevor was staying with his grandmother but the situation at home was hard. Feeding was hard, the house was not good and the grand mother could not afford paying school fees for the grand children since she’s only a peasant farmer. Trevor was then taken in by Berakhah childcare for safety and proper care. He would like to become an engineer and his best food is rice and meat. During his free time, Trevor likes to sing and dance as well as playing football. Trevor’s parents separated and left the children under the care of the grandmother. With your support, Trevor can realize his dream of becoming an engineer.

children.name: Wadada Brian
story: Brian is 14 years old and lives with his maternal grandmother. He lost his father at the age of eight, and his mother later remarried, leaving him under his grandmother’s care. She works hard as a peasant laborer on local plantations to provide for his basic needs. Brian is a disciplined and motivated student who values education and performs well in school. He dreams of becoming a teacher in the future, your sponsorship will give Brian the support he needs to continue his studies and work toward his goal.

children.name: Wadamba Jordan
story: Jordan is 10 years old, he’s in primary four and he lives with his parents. Jordan’s parents are peasant farmers and they depend on the garden produce to provide for the family needs and pay school fees for 8 children. Jordan loves going to school and he would like to become a doctor in future, his best subject is Mathematics and his best dish is rice and beans. Jordan loves doing some house chores like cutting grass for 2 cows and slashing around home. In his free time, Jordan likes playing football and singing. With your support Jordan can achieve his dream.

children.name: Wadeya Timothy
story: Timothy is a 13 year old, who stays with his grandfather, a peasant farmer. The grandfather is unable to raise school fees for him and offer him some basic needs like clothing and proper meals. Feeding is one of the major problems in Timothy’s home and the state of the house Timothy is staying is not good. Timothy would like to be a soldier in future, his best subjects are Mathematics and P/E. Timothy while at home he does domestic chores and he helps the grandfather in hawking vegetables after school. Your support towards Timothy will help him to stay in school and to have a better shelter over his head.

children.name: Wafula Joel
story: Joel is 16 years old in senior two class, he dreams of becoming a medical doctor despite facing numerous challenges. After his parents’ separation at 4 years old, Joel has solely depended on his mother who is a peasant farmer for support in education and basic needs. However, her limited earnings from farming cannot sustain her family and Joel has not been a regular student at school because of failure to pay school dues on time. Joel dreams pf becoming a doctor someday to serve his community and the family as well. With your support Joel can make it.

children.name: Wafula Zeverio
story: Zeverio is 14 years old and he’s in primary six. He is the third born in a family of six children, he lives with his parents and they are peasant farmers. They find it very difficult to meet all the family basic needs with no assured source of income. Zeverio a midst the family challenges is hopeful to become a doctor. At home he does some house chores like fetching water washing utensils, collecting firewood, digging. During his free time Zeverio likes to play football with his friends and grazing goats. Your sponsorship will help Zeverio to become a doctor.

children.name: Wakilo Partrick
story: Patrick is 9 years old in primary two. Patrick and his other 7 siblings stay with their father following the separation of her parents. His father works on construction sites to be able to raise some money to take care of the family, while at the site he got an accident which injured his back and because of this he can’t do much to provide for his family. Patrick loves attending school because he would like to be a lawyer, unfortunately he has always been a fees defaulter which keeps him away from school. Patrick loves playing football and running while at home he loves fetching water and playing with her mates. Your generous contribution towards Patrick’s education will enable her become a lawyer in future.

children.name: Wakiro Dan
story: Dan is 6 years old and he’s in primary two, he lives with his parents who are peasant farmers.  Despite financial struggles that make it difficult to provide for basic needs and secure better shelter, Dan excels academically. His good health is a blessing a midst the challenges, allowing him to focus on his studies. Dan would like to become a teacher, and his best sport is playing football with friends. Dan can excel through academics if he’s supported.

children.name: Wambede Aoron
story: Aaron is10 years old, he is in primary two. His dream is to become a police man in future. He lives with his parents, who are peasant farmers struggling to provide for their family’s daily needs and school expenses. Aaron is often sent home from school due to unpaid fees, which affects his learning. His father also works as a boda boda rider to supplement on his income and his mother is a house wife. He enjoys playing soccer and making new friends. Your kind support will enable Aaron to continue his education and work towards his dream of becoming an army officer.

children.name: Wambede Emma
story: Emma is 11 years old, he is in primary 3 and lives with his father and the step mother. His mother left the home when Emma was 7 years old.  Emma is a very active boy in almost all areas, at home he loves doing home chores by assisting his parents in fetching water, cleaning the compound etc, at church he loves cleaning church, singing and volunteering to take care of young ones and at school Emma’s performance is good and he would like to become a doctor. His parents are both peasant farmers and to supplement on their incomes his mother sells milk that she gets from the one cow at home and his father hawks some of the garden produce in the community to be able to take care of the family. For Emma to realize his dream of becoming a doctor, he needs support to be able to attend and stay in school.

children.name: Wambede Nasuru
story: Nasuru lost both of his parents when he was still young. His father died when he was 2 years old while his mother died when he was 12 years . It was not easy for him and the siblings to survive as total orphans. He had to live with various families after his parents died in search for what to eat. In exchange for food, he had to cut grass for the cows, collect water and do other domestic chores for people. Berakhah childcare spotted him and took him in, he was taken to school, care for and was loved. Nasuru is now doing an ICT course which and he’s in his first year. At Berakhah childcare, he participates in drumming, dancing and singing. He has hope for a bright future because he has access to all his basic needs. He has found love and the bond is great with the new family where he learns to freely express himself. Your sponsorship will be greatly appreciated to help him finish his course of ICT which he’s currently pursuing and his performance so far is good.

children.name: Wambede Peter Paul
story: Paul is a 12 year old lives with his step mother and his father, He was abandoned by his mother when he was still very young after the separation of his parents. His parents are facing a problem of paying school fees because they are just mere peasants. Paul loves playing foot ball and he would like to become a soccer player. At home Paul loves to do home chores and he loves attending school. Paul’s step mother can only cater for her own children because her income is very low and his father rarely supports which makes it impossible for Paul to attend school regularly. Your support will help Paul to attend school regularly and will achieve his goal.

children.name: Wambode Ivan
story: Ivan is 16 years old and he is in primary six, he comes from a family of eight children and is the fourth born. He previously lived with his father and stepmother, but life was difficult, he often missed meals, denied school, and faced frequent mistreatment. Fortunately, Berakhah Child Care rescued him and provided a safe and loving home. Ivan is a bright and disciplined student who balances his daily activities especially playing football with strong academic performance. He dreams of becoming an engineer in the future and is determined to achieve his goals with the support of kind sponsors and well wishers.

children.name: Wamola John
story: John is in primary two and lives with his father and stepmother after losing his biological mother, who passed away shortly after giving birth to him and his two sisters, they’re triplets. His father, a peasant farmer and charcoal seller, works hard to support the family but earns very little to meet the needs of all five children. Despite the challenges, John is an active and joyful boy who loves school and enjoys playing soccer. He helps with house chores at home and dreams of becoming a builder one day. With support, John can continue his education and move closer to achieving his dream.

children.name: Wanadwadi Joseph
story: Joseph is 15 years old. He is the eldest of five children. Life became very hard since their mother left them, before she left, their father would often come home drunk, beating their mother and neglecting them. Many times, he didn’t provide food, medicine, or school fees. After she ran away, things got even worse. Their father would disappear for days, leaving them with no food or care. As the oldest, he had to take care of his younger brothers. They begged for food around the neighborhood, but it wasn’t enough. They became weak and sick, and jiggers painfully infested their hands, feet, and elbows. Their house was falling apart, with holes in the walls that let in rain, soaking their beddings. When Berakhah learnt about their plight, it rescued them and brought them to a safe place, gave them food, medicine, clothes, and sent them to school. Joseph is now safe, cared for, and full of hope. He loves reading, listening to music, playing football, and his favorite meal is rice and chicken. His dream is to become a doctor. Your sponsorship can provide him with the education he needs to make my dreams come true.

children.name: Wandera Allan
story: Allan is 14 years old. He comes from a small village in Namayingo district, near Lake Victoria in Uganda. He was born with a condition which made his stomach swell and hurt all the time, he could only use the restroom once every 3 months. No one in my village understood what was wrong with him. His mom thought it was a curse or witchcraft. Life was hard from the very beginning. When he was just seven months old, his father died, leaving his mother to care for him and his three older siblings. She worked so hard, while battling HIV/ AIDS and didn’t have the money or knowledge to get him the help he needed, For ten years, he lived with this pain. He couldn’t run, play, or be like the other kids or attend school, Berakhah childcare found him and told his mother that Allan`s condition wasn’t a curse—it was something medical, and it could be treated. They took him in, loved him, and made sure he got the surgeries he needed to save his life. Now, Allan`s life is completely different. The pain is gone, the swelling is gone and he feels strong again. He is in school, learning and dreaming of a bright future. He also participates in the Berakhah Children’s Choir and helps with the media team at the children’s Church.

children.name: Waniala Boniface
story: Boniface is 14 years old in primary five. He lives with his parents who have no descent job to be able to provide for their children, his parents try their best to provide but in most cases they failed. Boniface performs very well in school and he would like to become a pilot so he can support his parents in their old age. In his free time, Boniface loves to play football and riding his bicycle. Your sponsorship will help Boniface to rewrite his story.

children.name: Wanyenya Patience
story: Patience is16 years old and she is Primary five staying at Berakhah Child Care. She is living with sickle cell disease, which has greatly affected her health and childhood. Her parents, who are peasant farmers, struggled to provide her with proper treatment due to limited income. Sadly, Patience is not the only child in her family suffering from sickle cell disease, two of her siblings are also victims. Managing treatment for all three children became an unbearable financial burden for her parents, who also have three other children depending on them. When Berakhah learned about the family’s situation, they decided to take Patience under their care. She now receives proper medication, nutritious meals, and the opportunity to attend school regularly. This support has also helped ease the family’s burden, allowing her parents to focus on the other children at home. Patience dreams of becoming a doctor in the future. With continued support, she can complete her education and receive consistent medical care to live a healthier, brighter life.

children.name: Wasukira Deo
story: Deo is  9 years old boy who lives with his aunt and seven other family members. His aunt works as a market vendor, earning just enough to provide food for the day, with little or nothing left to cover school fees and other basic needs. Because of these financial struggles, Deo is often sent home from school for unpaid fees, yet he remains determined and performs well academically. He dreams of becoming a teacher so he can help educate and uplift his community. With the support of a sponsor, Deo can stay in school, continue excelling in his studies, and work toward achieving his dream.

children.name: Wekoye Bob
story: Bob is 13years old, after his parents separated Bob was taken to stay with his grandmother. His grandmother is a widow who earns her living from selling some food stuffs she grows, she’s taking care of over 6 grandchildren and they are all of school going age, from her incomes, meeting their needs is impossible because even her health doesn’t allow her to work so hard. Bob enjoys helping his grandmother in the garden and at home with home chores, when he grows up Bob dreams of becoming an agriculturalist, he loves playing soccer and creating new friends.

children.name: Wosaza Hussein
story: Hussein used to live with his mother. She is a peasant who works on people’s gardens to make ends meet. His father died before his birth, Hussein got other 12 siblings when his mother remarried to a polygamous man. The family has no access to basic needs as they only have the mother to look up to, At home, Hussein would dig, clean the house, fetch water, cook and wash clothes. He would also grazes cow to contribute to his family`s welfare. He is in senior three and his performance is promising. His hobbies are; volley ball, athletics and debating. Being part of Berakhah childcare, Hussein participates in drumming, dancing and singing. He likes caring for others and studying the Bible. Hussein is full of life and hope and he hopes to be a doctor in future to support his mother and siblings. Your sponsorship will help his dream become a reality.
